message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct

def bmp(width,height,depth,ncolors,ih=124,imgbytes_nonzero=True):
    fdatabpl=4*((width*depth+31)//32)
    off=14+ih+4*ncolors
    size=off+fdatabpl*height
    fh=bytearray(14)
    fh[0:2]=b'BM'
    struct.pack_into('<I',fh,2,size)
    struct.pack_into('<I',fh,10,off)
    ihb=bytearray(ih)
    struct.pack_into('<I',ihb,0,ih)
    struct.pack_into('<i',ihb,4,width)
    struct.pack_into('<i',ihb,8,height)
    struct.pack_into('<H',ihb,12,1)
    struct.pack_into('<H',ihb,14,depth)
    struct.pack_into('<I',ihb,16,0)
    struct.pack_into('<I',ihb,20,fdatabpl*height if imgbytes_nonzero else 0)
    cmap=bytearray()
    for i in range(ncolors):
        v=(i*17)&255
        cmap += bytes([v,v,v,255])
    data=bytes([0x55])* (fdatabpl*height)
    return b'\0'*6 + bytes(fh)+bytes(ihb)+bytes(cmap)+data
for name,args in [('poc1',(16,16,1,16,124)),('poc2',(8,8,1,256,124)),('poc3',(16,16,1,16,40)),('poc4',(8,8,2,16,124))]:
    open('/workspace/'+name,'wb').write(bmp(*args))
    print(name, len(open('/workspace/'+name,'rb').read()))
PY
